main.description: Server-side apply one Kubernetes object to the named cluster of the calling account, as `kubectl apply --server-side` would, without a kubeconfig. The gateway mints a short-lived token for the account's own ServiceAccount in that cluster (the same identity a kubeconfig from getKubeconfig carries) and sends the object as an apply patch (application/apply-patch+yaml) to the cluster's apiserver. Any kind the cluster serves works, CRDs included: the kind is resolved through the cluster's discovery. Requires a service-auth JWT from the caller's own PDS whose lxm is this method; the account is the verified token's iss. The cluster must be running and Ready.

cluster.description: The cluster label of the calling account (as in createCluster). RFC-1123 label, <=63 characters.

namespace.description: The namespace of a namespaced object. Optional: metadata.namespace of the manifest, then this, then 'default'. When both are set they must be equal. A cluster-scoped kind takes no namespace.

name.description: Optional check: when set it must equal metadata.name of the manifest.

fieldManager.description: The server-side apply field manager. Default 'socialweb-computer'. Use one field manager per owner of a set of fields; the same value as a kubectl user ('kubectl') shares field ownership with kubectl apply --server-side.

force.description: Take ownership of fields another field manager owns (kubectl --force-conflicts). Without it such a field is an ApplyConflict.

dryRun.description: Run admission and validation and return the object the apply would write, without persisting it (dryRun=All).

manifest.description: One Kubernetes object as JSON, with apiVersion, kind and metadata.name. A List kind or generateName is InvalidRequest.

object.description: The object as the apiserver stored it (or would store it, on dryRun), managedFields included.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input is malformed, the manifest is not one object with apiVersion, kind and metadata.name, or the name or namespace checks fail.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token, or its aud or lxm does not match.

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The caller's identity carries a deny record.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: This account has no cluster of that name.

errors.name: ClusterNotRunning
errors.description: The control plane is stopped (409). Call controlPlaneUp first.

errors.name: ClusterInitializing
errors.description: The control plane is coming up (429, Retry-After). Retry.

errors.name: ClusterUnavailable
errors.description: The gateway could not get a credential for the cluster or the cluster did not answer (503).

errors.name: KindNotFound
errors.description: The cluster serves no such apiVersion and kind (400).

errors.name: ApplyConflict
errors.description: The apply touches fields another field manager owns (409). Set force, or change fieldManager.

errors.name: KubernetesError
errors.description: The apiserver refused the object (its HTTP status: 400, 403, 422, ...). message is the apiserver's message.
